claim_ceiling: Declarative synthetic tests only. No country legal assessment, government authority, currency provider, standards certification, operational interoperability, or production readiness is established.

region_groups.name: Pacific, Oceania and remote coastal contexts

cases.name: UN/LOCODE production versus prerelease
cases.setup: One provider sends a location reference present in the UN/LOCODE prerelease but absent from the pinned production publication.
cases.negative_control: Never silently promote prerelease to production.

cases.name: Port location code misused as berth ID
cases.setup: A UN/LOCODE port-level identifier is supplied where a specific marina berth identifier is required.
cases.negative_control: Do not infer a unique berth from a port location code.

cases.name: Pleasure yacht without IMO number
cases.setup: Small recreational craft is not eligible for an IMO ship number and supplies a national registry record.
cases.negative_control: No universal IMO-number requirement or name-only identity matching.

cases.name: Ship versus company identifier confusion
cases.setup: An IMO company/registered-owner number is supplied as a vessel identifier.
cases.negative_control: Never accept one subject class as another.

cases.name: Currency with zero minor units
cases.setup: A valid quote uses a currency whose ISO 4217 minor unit is zero.
cases.negative_control: Do not assume every currency has two decimal places.

cases.name: Currency with three minor units
cases.setup: A valid quote uses a currency whose ISO 4217 minor unit is three.
cases.negative_control: No hard-coded two-decimal parser or display rounding into authority.

cases.name: Currency metadata changed or historical
cases.setup: A replayed quote references an older currency metadata snapshot and a later currency metadata revision exists.
cases.negative_control: Do not reinterpret historical amount_minor using mutable latest metadata.

cases.name: Quote currency differs from settlement currency
cases.setup: Provider quotes in one currency and payment provider settles in another.
cases.negative_control: No implicit exchange rate or FX finality.

cases.name: Non-whole-hour timezone offset
cases.setup: Local schedule uses a region with a half-hour or quarter-hour UTC offset.
cases.negative_control: Do not round offsets to whole hours.

cases.name: Daylight-saving gap and fold
cases.setup: Booking cutoff occurs in a DST transition gap or repeated local time.
cases.negative_control: No silent resolver choice.

cases.name: tzdb update after future schedule creation
cases.setup: An IANA timezone rule changes after a future local schedule is recorded.
cases.negative_control: Do not rewrite source timestamp or treat old future conversion as current without review.

cases.name: Date-only deadline versus UTC event instant
cases.setup: Cancellation or check-in policy defines a local calendar date while a provider receipt supplies an instant.
cases.negative_control: Do not coerce date-only value to UTC midnight.

cases.name: Arabic RTL and mixed-script fields
cases.setup: Provider/locality has Arabic right-to-left text mixed with Latin identifiers and numerals.
cases.negative_control: Do not reorder or corrupt signed identifier/source fields.

cases.name: Chinese, Cyrillic and diacritic-bearing names
cases.setup: Providers and locations use non-Latin scripts, transliterations and diacritic variants.
cases.negative_control: Do not fuzzy-merge distinct entities based on transliteration.

cases.name: Unreviewed machine translation of contract term
cases.setup: A contract or cancellation clause has a machine translation but no competent review.
cases.negative_control: Do not accept translated term as authoritative legal/provider wording.

cases.name: Locale decimal formatting differs
cases.setup: Same source amount displayed in locales with different decimal/group separators.
cases.negative_control: Locale formatting cannot alter amount_minor or currency exponent.

cases.name: Incompatible physical dimensions
cases.setup: Provider maps a volume to a mass field or power to energy without density/time conversion evidence.
cases.negative_control: Unit labels alone are not dimensional equivalence.

cases.name: Nautical to SI conversion
cases.setup: Vessel dimension or maritime speed is converted between nautical/legacy and SI representations.
cases.negative_control: Preserve source value/unit, conversion version, rounding and uncertainty.

cases.name: MSW acknowledgement versus private stay confirmation
cases.setup: Private provider StayManifest is presented as evidence of a public MSW filing or clearance.
cases.negative_control: Private confirmation cannot satisfy government submission/acceptance/clearance.

cases.name: Conflicting jurisdiction overlay versions
cases.setup: Two overlays claim overlapping geographic scope with inconsistent effective dates or authorities.
cases.negative_control: No last-write-wins legal applicability.

cases.name: Cross-border data transfer prohibited or unreviewed
cases.setup: A profile's data transfer/residency policy conflicts with destination processing request.
cases.negative_control: Global network membership does not override local data governance.

cases.name: Low bandwidth and intermittent provider connectivity
cases.setup: Provider can receive small metadata asynchronously but cannot provide real-time read-back.
cases.negative_control: No cache is promoted to live availability or reservation.

cases.name: Manual provider workflow joins later
cases.setup: Small provider has no public API and later supplies an operator-signed/manual confirmation through an authorized channel.
cases.negative_control: Do not label manual evidence as automated integration or elevate beyond its issuer scope.

cases.name: Identifier revoked or reassigned
cases.setup: A local registry identifier expires, is revoked or is reassigned under its issuing authority's rules.
cases.negative_control: Historical references remain immutable; current action requires fresh subject binding.

cases.name: No verified local registry endpoint
cases.setup: A remote island/coastal region has no verified machine-readable provider/registry endpoint.
cases.negative_control: Do not fabricate an endpoint, coverage or legal status.

cases.name: IMO Compendium profile updated
cases.setup: Adapter compiled against FAL.5/Circ.55 receives a field added/changed in FAL.5/Circ.56.
cases.negative_control: No silent latest alias or false full coverage claim.

cases.name: Regional pack is research-only
cases.setup: A country pack has source links but no local legal review or authority approval.
cases.negative_control: Research-only status must block compliance/production claims.

cases.name: Community rule conflicts with statutory rule
cases.setup: Community access policy attempts to bypass port-entry or navigation restriction.
cases.negative_control: Community membership or reciprocity cannot override competent public authority.

cases.name: Vessel has multiple issuer identifiers
cases.setup: A vessel has IMO, national registry, MMSI and call sign records with different issuers and lifecycle.
cases.negative_control: No unqualified identifier transitivity or one field overwriting another.

cases.name: Unreviewed locale fallback
cases.setup: Preferred language unavailable; system proposes fallback for price/cancellation/safety content.
cases.negative_control: No silent acceptance or implied user comprehension.
